component: Calendar attachment item lifecycle and link delegation

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The item clones its template once, then reapplies existing label, URL and icon attributes. Pre-connection callbacks return early, so that replay supplies the initial anchor and image state. Later changes update textContent/href and clear whichever src/srcset representation is unused. Clicking delegates to LinkHelper without adding history. Attribute tests do not establish link activation or accessible output; integration is a separate phase.
title: Calendar attachment items replay initial attributes after connection
